scope.matching_policy: Only exact pack_path identity and explicit report keys are admissible across G13-B, G14-B, and G15-B.
scope.state_policy: Copy blocked or observed_local states conservatively; no state is promoted by G16.
scope.evidence_request_policy: Every pack receives an open evidence request reference; queued packs copy G14-B requirements and the non-queued matched pack retains G13-B remediation references.
scope.remediation_policy: Every pack retains G13-B and G15-B remediation references; G14-B blocker references are added when a queue item exists.
scope.no_semantic_mapping: Course names, COURSE.yaml fonti, titles, topics, and text similarity are not matching bases and do not create source relationships.
excluded_payloads: Source files, source text, PDFs, XML, HTML, manuals, standards, prices, manufacturer data, schede JSONL, exams, answers, and solutions
Independent legal, technical, factual, licence, or regulatory conclusions

evidence: An explicit source record identifies the source_record_id, exact title, version or date, language, and rights holder.
The source evidence artifact or an explicitly permitted local evidence reference is registered without copying protected payloads into this queue.
The evidence identity is reproducible through a declared hash or equivalent immutable proof and an observation date/method.
Each material claim has an explicit source-record relationship; evidence is not inferred from course text, titles, topics, or similarity.
locator: An exact official URL or exact local path is declared for the source evidence.
A stable page, section, table, anchor, fragment, or record locator identifies the relevant evidence when the source format supports it.
The locator has an observation/retrieval date and is tied to the declared source version and territory.
A locator is not treated as proof of content accuracy, licence, or legal clearance by itself.
license_proof: Source-specific licence, terms, public-domain basis, or written permission is identified by an exact URL/path or retained proof reference.
Rights holder, attribution, commercial use, modification, redistribution, scraping, ShareAlike/copyleft, NC/ND, and exclusions are recorded where applicable.
A proof snapshot or hash makes the licence evidence reproducible and preserves its scope, version, territory, and observation date.
Any unresolved rights question remains blocked and is not converted into a claim-ready or reuse-approved state.
